name: Keyboardrowshiftcipher

description_json.name: KeyboardRowShiftCipher
description_json.idea: Shift each letter to its immediate right neighbor on a standard QWERTY keyboard row, wrapping around to the start of the same row. Case is preserved, and non-alphabetic characters remain unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules: For each letter, locate its position on the standard QWERTY keyboard rows. Row 1: 'qwertyuiop', Row 2: 'asdfghjkl', Row 3: 'zxcvbnm'. Shift the letter to the right by 1 position within its row, wrapping around to the beginning of the row if it is the last letter (e.g., 'p' becomes 'q', 'l' becomes 'a', 'm' becomes 'z'). Maintain the original case of the letter. All non-alphabetic characters (spaces, punctuation, digits) remain completely unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules: For each letter, locate its position on the standard QWERTY keyboard rows. Row 1: 'qwertyuiop', Row 2: 'asdfghjkl', Row 3: 'zxcvbnm'. Shift the letter to the left by 1 position within its row, wrapping around to the end of the row if it is the first letter (e.g., 'q' becomes 'p', 'a' becomes 'l', 'z' becomes 'm'). Maintain the original case of the letter. All non-alphabetic characters (spaces, punctuation, digits) remain completely unchanged.

prompt:

Maintain the original case of the letter. All non-alphabetic characters (spaces, punctuation, digits) remain completely unchanged.
-decryption: For each letter, locate its position on the standard QWERTY keyboard rows. Row 1: 'qwertyuiop', Row 2: 'asdfghjkl', Row 3: 'zxcvbnm'. Shift the letter to the left by 1 position within its row, wrapping around to the end of the row if it is the first letter (e.g., 'q' becomes 'p', 'a' becomes 'l', 'z' becomes 'm'). Maintain the original case of the letter. All non-alphabetic characters (spaces, punctuation, digits) remain completely unchanged.
